title: 3Sum
description: Find all unique triplets in the array that sum to zero. Print each triplet in non-decreasing order on its own line; list triplets in lexicographic order. Print `none` if there is no triplet.
input_format: First line: N. Second line: N space-separated integers.

title: Container With Most Water
description: Given N vertical lines with the given heights, choose two lines that together with the x-axis hold the most water. Print the maximum area.
input_format: First line: N. Second line: N space-separated integers.

title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
description: Given daily stock prices, buy once and sell once later to maximise profit. Print the maximum profit (0 if no profit is possible).
input_format: First line: N. Second line: N space-separated integers.

title: Contains Duplicate
description: Print `true` if any value appears at least twice, otherwise `false`.
input_format: First line: N. Second line: N space-separated integers.

title: Missing Number
description: An array holds N distinct numbers from 0..N. Print the one number in that range that is missing.
input_format: First line: N. Second line: N space-separated integers.
sample_explanation: The range is 0..3 and 2 is missing.

title: Find All Numbers Disappeared in an Array
description: Given N integers in the range 1..N (duplicates allowed), print every number in 1..N that does not appear, in ascending order.
input_format: First line: N. Second line: N space-separated integers.
output_format: Space-separated missing numbers (at least one is always missing).

title: Intersection of Two Arrays
description: Print the distinct values that appear in both arrays, in ascending order (at least one common value exists).
input_format: First line: N and M. Second line: N integers (array 1). Third line: M integers (array 2).

title: Intersection of Two Arrays II
description: Print the multiset intersection of the two arrays (each value as many times as it appears in both), in ascending order.
input_format: First line: N and M. Second line: N integers (array 1). Third line: M integers (array 2).

title: Plus One
description: A non-negative integer is given as an array of digits (most significant first). Add one and print the resulting digits.
input_format: First line: N. Second line: N digits.

title: Move Zeroes
description: Move all zeros to the end while keeping the order of the other elements. Print the array.
input_format: First line: N. Second line: N space-separated integers.
sample_explanation: Non-zero values keep order: 1 3 12, then two zeros.

title: Find Pivot Index
description: Print the leftmost index where the sum of elements to its left equals the sum to its right, or -1 if none exists.
input_format: First line: N. Second line: N space-separated integers.
sample_explanation: Left sum 11 equals right sum 11 at index 3.

title: Running Sum of 1D Array
description: Print the running sums: element i of the output is the sum of the first i + 1 elements.
input_format: First line: N. Second line: N space-separated integers.

title: Squares of a Sorted Array
description: Given a sorted array, print the squares of each number in non-decreasing order.
input_format: First line: N. Second line: N space-separated integers.

title: Majority Element (Boyer-Moore Voting)
description: Print the element that appears more than N/2 times (it always exists).
input_format: First line: N. Second line: N space-separated integers.

title: Pascal's Triangle
description: Print the first N rows of Pascal's triangle, one row per line.
input_format: A single integer N.
sample_explanation: Each number is the sum of the two above it.

title: Pascal's Triangle II
description: Print row K (0-indexed) of Pascal's triangle.
input_format: A single integer K.

title: Product of Array Except Self
description: For each index print the product of all other elements, without using division.
input_format: First line: N. Second line: N space-separated integers.

title: Subarray Sum Equals K
description: Print the number of contiguous subarrays whose sum equals K.
input_format: First line: N and K. Second line: N space-separated integers.

title: Maximum Product Subarray
description: Print the largest product of any contiguous subarray.
input_format: First line: N. Second line: N space-separated integers.

title: Find the Duplicate Number
description: An array of N integers contains values in 1..N-1 and exactly one value repeats (possibly several times). Print the repeated value.
input_format: First line: N. Second line: N space-separated integers.

title: Next Permutation
description: Print the next lexicographically greater permutation of the array. If none exists, print the lowest (sorted ascending) order.
input_format: First line: N. Second line: N space-separated integers.

title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
description: Print the length of the longest run of consecutive integers that can be formed from the array elements (order in the array does not matter).
input_format: First line: N. Second line: N space-separated integers.

title: Array Nesting
description: Given a permutation of 0..N-1, for each start index i follow i -> nums[i] -> nums[nums[i]] ... until a value repeats. Print the largest set size reached.
input_format: First line: N. Second line: N space-separated integers.

title: Continuous Subarray Sum
description: Print `true` if some subarray of length at least 2 has a sum that is a multiple of K, otherwise `false`.
input_format: First line: N and K. Second line: N space-separated integers.

title: Subarray Sums Divisible by K
description: Print the number of non-empty contiguous subarrays whose sum is divisible by K.
input_format: First line: N and K. Second line: N space-separated integers.
sample_explanation: Seven subarrays have a sum divisible by 5.

title: First Missing Positive
description: Print the smallest positive integer that does not appear in the array.
input_format: First line: N. Second line: N space-separated integers.
sample_explanation: 1 and 2 exist, so 3 is the first missing.

title: Candy Distribution
description: Children stand in a line with ratings. Each child needs at least one candy, and a child with a higher rating than a neighbour must get more candies than that neighbour. Print the minimum total candies.
input_format: First line: N. Second line: N space-separated integers.

title: Largest Rectangle in Histogram
description: Given bar heights (each bar has width 1), print the area of the largest rectangle in the histogram.
input_format: First line: N. Second line: N space-separated integers.
sample_explanation: Bars 5 and 6 form a 2 x 5 = 10 rectangle.

title: Sliding Window Maximum
description: For every window of size K sliding across the array, print the maximum value in the window.
input_format: First line: N and K. Second line: N space-separated integers.

title: Valid Palindrome
description: A phrase is a palindrome if, after lowercasing and removing every non-alphanumeric character, it reads the same forwards and backwards. Print `true` or `false`.
input_format: A single line containing the string.
sample_input: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama

test_cases.input: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama

title: Reverse String
description: Print the string reversed.
input_format: A single line containing the string.

title: Reverse Vowels of a String
description: Reverse only the vowels (a, e, i, o, u in either case) of the string and print it.
input_format: A single line containing the string.
sample_explanation: Vowels e and o swap: holle.

title: Is Subsequence
description: Print `true` if the first string is a subsequence of the second (characters appear in order, not necessarily adjacent), otherwise `false`.
input_format: Two lines: string s, then string t.
sample_explanation: a, b, c appear in order in t.

title: Longest Mountain in Array
description: A mountain is a subarray of length at least 3 that strictly increases to a peak and then strictly decreases. Print the length of the longest mountain, or 0 if none exists.
input_format: First line: N. Second line: N space-separated integers.

title: Subarrays with K Different Integers
description: Print the number of contiguous subarrays that contain exactly K distinct integers.
input_format: First line: N and K. Second line: N space-separated integers.
sample_explanation: Seven subarrays have exactly 2 distinct values.

title: Minimum Size Subarray Sum
description: Given positive integers and a target K, print the minimal length of a contiguous subarray whose sum is at least K, or 0 if none exists.
input_format: First line: N and K. Second line: N space-separated integers.
sample_explanation: The subarray [4,3] has the minimal length 2.

title: Permutation in String
description: Given strings s1 and s2, print `true` if some permutation of s1 is a substring of s2, otherwise `false`.
input_format: Two lines: s1, then s2.
sample_explanation: ba is a permutation of ab and appears in s2.

title: Find All Anagrams in a String
description: Given strings s and p, print the start index of every substring of s that is an anagram of p, in ascending order (at least one exists).
input_format: Two lines: s, then p.

title: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
description: You may replace at most K characters of the string with any uppercase letter. Print the length of the longest substring of identical letters you can obtain.
input_format: First line: string s (uppercase). Second line: integer K.
sample_explanation: Replace both A's (or B's) to get AAAA.

title: Minimum Window Substring
description: Given strings s and t, print the smallest substring of s that contains every character of t (with multiplicity). Print -1 if no such window exists.
input_format: Two lines: s, then t.
sample_explanation: BANC is the shortest window containing A, B and C.

title: Length of Last Word
description: Print the length of the last word in the string (words are separated by spaces).
input_format: A single line containing the string.

title: Longest Common Prefix
description: Print the longest common prefix of the given words, or -1 if there is none.
input_format: One line of space-separated words.

title: Transpose Matrix
description: Print the transpose of the matrix (rows become columns).
input_format: First line: R and C. Next R lines: C space-separated integers.

title: Flipping an Image
description: For a binary matrix, reverse every row and then invert every bit (0 becomes 1, 1 becomes 0). Print the result.
input_format: First line: R and C. Next R lines: C space-separated integers.

title: Matrix Diagonal Sum
description: Print the sum of the primary and secondary diagonals of a square matrix (count the centre cell once).
input_format: First line: R and C. Next R lines: C space-separated integers.

title: Spiral Matrix
description: Print the elements of the matrix in clockwise spiral order.
input_format: First line: R and C. Next R lines: C space-separated integers.

title: Spiral Matrix II
description: Print an N x N matrix filled with 1..N*N in clockwise spiral order.
input_format: A single integer N.

title: Rotate Image (In-Place 90 Degrees)
description: Rotate a square matrix 90 degrees clockwise and print it.
input_format: First line: R and C. Next R lines: C space-separated integers.
sample_explanation: The first column read bottom to top becomes the first row.

title: Set Matrix Zeroes
description: If a cell is 0, set its entire row and column to 0. Print the resulting matrix.
input_format: First line: R and C. Next R lines: C space-separated integers.
sample_explanation: The zero at (1,1) clears row 1 and column 1.

title: Search a 2D Matrix
description: Each row of the matrix is sorted and the first value of each row is greater than the last value of the previous row. Print `true` if the target exists, otherwise `false`.
input_format: First line: R and C. Next R lines: C integers. Last line: the target.

title: Search a 2D Matrix II
description: Each row is sorted left to right and each column is sorted top to bottom. Print `true` if the target exists, otherwise `false`.
input_format: First line: R and C. Next R lines: C integers. Last line: the target.

title: Game of Life
description: Apply one step of Conway's Game of Life to a grid of 0 (dead) and 1 (live). A live cell with 2 or 3 live neighbours stays alive; a dead cell with exactly 3 live neighbours becomes alive; all others die or stay dead. Print the next grid.
input_format: First line: R and C. Next R lines: C space-separated integers.

title: Kth Smallest Element in a Sorted Matrix
description: Rows and columns of the matrix are sorted ascending. Print the K-th smallest element (counting duplicates).
input_format: First line: R and C. Next R lines: C integers. Last line: K.
sample_explanation: Sorted order puts 13 in the 8th position.

title: Linked List Cycle Detection
description: A singly linked list may contain a cycle: the tail's next pointer can point back to the node at index POS (0-indexed). POS = -1 means there is no cycle. The list is built for you; print `true` if the list has a cycle, otherwise `false`.
input_format: First line: N and POS. Second line: N integers (node values).
sample_explanation: The tail connects back to the node at index 1.

title: Min Stack
description: Design a stack that supports push, pop, top and retrieving the minimum element in constant time. Process the commands `push X`, `pop`, `top`, `getMin`. For `top` and `getMin` print the value.
input_format: First line: Q. Next Q lines: a command.
output_format: One line for every top and getMin command.
constraints: 1 <= Q <= 10^4; pop, top and getMin are only used on a non-empty stack.
sample_input:
7
push -2
push 0
push -3
getMin
pop
top
getMin
sample_explanation: After popping -3 the top is 0 and the minimum is -2.

test_cases.input:
7
push -2
push 0
push -3
getMin
pop
top
getMin

6
push 9
push 7
push 8
getMin
pop
getMin

title: LRU Cache (Doubly Linked List + Hash Map)
description: Design an LRU (least recently used) cache. The first command is `cap C` (capacity). `put K V` inserts or updates a key (evicting the least recently used key if the cache is full). `get K` prints the value, or -1 if the key is absent; both put and get make the key most recently used.
input_format: First line: Q. Next Q lines: `cap C` (first), then `put K V` or `get K`.
output_format: One line for every get command.
sample_input:
9
cap 2
put 1 1
put 2 2
get 1
put 3 3
get 2
put 4 4
get 1
get 3
sample_explanation: Key 2 is evicted by put 3, and key 1 by put 4.

test_cases.input:
9
cap 2
put 1 1
put 2 2
get 1
put 3 3
get 2
put 4 4
get 1
get 3

7
cap 2
put 1 1
put 2 2
put 1 10
put 3 3
get 1
get 2

6
cap 3
put 1 1
put 2 2
put 3 3
get 1
put 4 4
get 2

title: Invert Binary Tree
description: Invert (mirror) the binary tree by swapping the left and right child of every node. Print the inorder traversal of the inverted tree.
input_format: One line of space-separated level-order tokens. Use `null` for a missing child.

title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree
description: Given a binary tree and two node values P and Q that both exist in it, print the value of their lowest common ancestor (a node can be its own descendant).
input_format: Line 1: level-order tokens (`null` = missing child). Line 2: P and Q.
sample_explanation: The lowest common ancestor of 5 and 1 is 3.

title: Climbing Stairs
description: You climb a staircase of N steps taking 1 or 2 steps at a time. Print the number of distinct ways to reach the top.
input_format: A single integer N.

title: Longest Increasing Subsequence (LIS)
description: Print the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence of the array.
input_format: First line: N. Second line: N space-separated integers.

title: House Robber
description: Houses in a row hold money. You cannot rob two adjacent houses. Print the maximum amount you can rob.
input_format: First line: N. Second line: N space-separated integers.

title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
description: A sorted array of distinct integers was rotated at an unknown pivot. Print the index of the target, or -1 if it is absent.
input_format: First line: N and the target. Second line: N integers.

title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
description: Print the K-th largest element of the array (counting duplicates; K = 1 is the maximum).
input_format: First line: N and K. Second line: N space-separated integers.
sample_explanation: Sorted descending: 6 5 4 ..., so the 2nd largest is 5.

title: Subsets (Power Set)
description: Given distinct integers, print every subset. Within a subset list elements in the order given in the input. Order the subsets by size, and subsets of equal size by the positions of their elements. Print `empty` for the empty subset.
input_format: First line: N. Second line: N space-separated integers.

title: Quick Sort Implementation
description: Implement quick sort and print the array in ascending order.
input_format: First line: N. Second line: N space-separated integers.

title: Word Ladder (Shortest Path BFS)
description: Transform the begin word into the end word, changing one letter at a time; every intermediate word must be in the word list. Print the number of words in the shortest sequence (including begin and end), or 0 if impossible.
input_format: Line 1: beginWord and endWord. Line 2: the space-separated word list.
constraints: 1 <= words <= 5000, all words have equal length
sample_input:
hit cog
hot dot dog lot log cog
sample_explanation: hit -> hot -> dot -> dog -> cog has 5 words.

test_cases.input:
hit cog
hot dot dog lot log cog

hit cog
hot dot dog lot log

cat dog
cot cog dot dog

title: Flood Fill Algorithm (Graph DFS/BFS)
description: Starting at cell (SR, SC), recolour that cell and every 4-directionally connected cell of the same original colour with NEWCOLOR. Print the resulting image.
input_format: Line 1: R and C. Next R lines: C integers. Last line: SR SC NEWCOLOR.
sample_explanation: Cells connected to (1,1) with colour 1 become 2.

title: Surrounded Regions (Matrix DFS / Boundary Capture)
description: A grid contains `X` and `O`. Capture every region of `O` cells that is completely surrounded by `X` (flip it to `X`). An `O` connected to the border is never captured. Print the final grid.
input_format: First line: R and C. Next R lines: a string of C characters (`X` or `O`).
sample_explanation: Only the O touching the bottom border survives.

title: Number of Connected Components
description: An undirected graph has N nodes labelled 0..N-1 and M edges. Print the number of connected components.
input_format: First line: N and M. Next M lines: two node labels `u v`.
